notes: The explicit-id branch (lines 148-159) is checked FIRST and wins outright regardless of what WorldSlotManager.activeSlot currently reports -- "slot-a" being active is irrelevant once a caller supplies an id. explicitSlotName is trimmed of whitespace (line 149) and an empty result normalizes to nil (line 156). worldSeed is never taken from the caller -- it's looked up fresh via WorldSlotManager.loadSlots(...).first(where: { $0.id == explicitSlotId })?.worldSeed (lines 150-153), so it reflects the slot's current on-disk state even if stale by the time the caller's own slotName argument was captured.
